name: Tanks For Fun Road Rage Edition Demo V3.4
author: CaligoArts
description: *Updated to Version 3.4 on 2/25/2022 All updates will be announced through www.CaligoArts.com if you want to keep up with posted changes. *Please hit that little heart in the lower left corner to show some love if you liked the game. Thanks, it means a lot! ** *Ever get road rage bad enough to wish you could just get in a tank and smash into EVERYTHING without the fear of consequences? Drive a tank through populated city area's & traffic while smashing through whatever is in your way and blowing stuff up with the cannon. Crushing traffic while avoiding getting taken out by the cops. Rack up a high score by causing the most carnage possible & don't forget to stay stocked up on fuel or times up! Can you survive to the end? Please Wishlist the game by signing up for our news letter at CaligoArts.com. We don't spam & only send out New Game Release Info. Thanks for playing & hope you all enjoy! Please let us know what you think!
